exposure: Time interval between UAE and D&C (0-12 hours vs. 12-72 hours)
time interval between uterine artery embolization (UAE) and curettage modalities
outcome: time of CSP residual mass disappearance
finding: For patients with CSP, UAE followed by D&C on the same day (0-12 h) resulted in a shorter hospital stay, while the long time interval (12-72 h) may be associated with a lower risk of inflammation and a faster decrease in serum β-hCG level within 24 h after D&C surgery.
